note: Both sets capture the core Energy Balance thresholds and the 15-minute movie-night visit rule, but Set A additionally captures two page facts Set B omits entirely: the village is organized into five neighborhoods and organizers offer three movie options. Set B is padded with repeated display-brightness and figure-derived point claims whose quotes are only the figure caption or bare axis labels ('100', '0'), and one quote is altered with a bracketed insertion ('[0 kWh]') while another misbinds the brightness requirement to the condition 'showing supplied content'. Set A's weaknesses are two figure-caption-only quotes for point values, but it is otherwise more complete and better supported.
